subject: Next steps: 30-min product walkthrough & stakeholder times
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed 30-min walkthrough windows

Hi Emily —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for walking through Orchard Health's latency and cost pain points. Quick recap so we’re aligned: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-request token cost and median generation latency for triage assistant use case (peak: 200 rps internal tests).
- Constraints: PHI-sensitive workflows require VPC/private deployment evaluation and KMS integration for keys.
- Success metric: sub-300ms median for 512-token responses in production + <15% TCO increase over current infra.

Next step: a short 30-minute product walkthrough focused on how Redwood handles serving, KV cache reuse, and private deployment options. Monica (solutions engineer) will demo the runtime/observability; Rishi (account lead) will cover pricing/commit options briefly.

Can you share which of these windows work for your team (all PST):
1) Wed Aug 18 — 11:00–11:30am PST
2) Thu Aug 19 — 9:30–10:00am PST
3) Fri Aug 20 — 2:00–2:30pm PST

Agenda attached: short architecture demo, sample perf numbers, questions & next steps. If you prefer, tell me who else on your side should join (tech + procurement).

Thanks — talk soon,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0168
redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf

Alan (VP Product) should join from our side for the product/latency discussion; I’ll loop him in. Of the three slots you listed the best for us is Thu Aug 19 9:30am PST or Fri Aug 20 2:00pm PST.

Quick question before we lock the invite: do you have a short note on SSO options (SAML/Okta) and whether Redwood can support an audit log export for a dedicated/private install? Procurement will want to see that ahead of time.

Emily

Emily — thanks, and great to meet Alan (added above).

Short answers to your procurement questions:
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML/Okta for both Hosted and Private control planes; we can provide an SSO test plan and sample IdP metadata.
- Audit logs: yes — Dedicated and Private deployments include configurable audit log exports (JSON lines) and integration hooks for SIEM. We’ll include a one-page security summary in the pre-read.

We’re good to confirm Thu Aug 19 9:30–10:00am PST. Proposed attendee list:
- Orchard: Emily Zhang (CTO), Alan Kumar (VP Product), +1 engineer (TBD)
- Redwood: Marcus Lin (AE), Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer), Rishi Malhotra (Account Lead)

I attached the updated 30-min agenda and a short security summary (2 pages). Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite with a brief pre-read link.

Best,
Marcus
